vulnerability_mechanism.detail: Checkpoint-controlled config.dump supplies RootfsImageRef and RootfsImageName; CRImportCheckpoint pulled the former and created a local image record named by the latter, enabling first-writer tag poisoning consumed by later IfNotPresent/Never pods. The authoritative GHSA describes this same mechanism.

atomic_bic.detail: git log -S and the parent diff independently identify 9e6beafd53919eecd1fb650a76332002cf4c84dd as the first public writer of CRImportCheckpoint and tagImage.Name = config.RootfsImageName.

immediate_parent_absence.detail: The sole parent 07dd4ccf3599d4c22ee679b36fda3a17f8801cc2 contains checkpoint export metadata but no CRImportCheckpoint or tagImage.Name sink; the vulnerable sink appears in the BIC diff.

squash_member_decomposition.detail: Merge commit 9b552d441582d71b7fd322c0b9f2c7c23b26b729 has 9e6beafd53919eecd1fb650a76332002cf4c84dd as its second parent; the branch merge-base is the BIC parent and the range contains exactly one commit, so there is no hidden squash/member finer than the BIC.

affected_fixed_release_membership.detail: The sink is absent in v2.0.0, present in v2.1.0/v2.1.8, v2.2.4, and v2.3.1, then absent in v2.1.9, v2.2.5, and v2.3.2. Each release-line backport is an ancestor of its fixed tag, matching the GHSA ranges.

direct_fix_or_unpatched_state.detail: 0c0918fa8fb4d997f889a3d811603995a3a2b68a directly deletes the ImageService Get/Create retag block: it is present in parent 799ecd2926eacc91cd4065c07e8695cd8e6857dc and absent after the fix. Backports dae67765f2d51ca3e67190c26e51edf496dd4cf4, cff57884176a1e6ba0857a417753d799958e0f46, and 2e4583a9f7934961f47a5c4bba6ea779dce95635 have the same stable patch-id.

bic_only_ai_attribution.detail: The BIC object names Adrian Reber as human author and committer and contains only his Signed-off-by trailer; no AI/bot author, committer, or AI-assistance trailer is present. Advisory AI discovery credits and later AI-marked commits do not alter BIC authorship.

findings: The NOT_AI causal conclusion is supported, but the primary record sets introducer_parent_absent=false while its own evidence and independent parent-tree replay prove that the vulnerable CRImportCheckpoint retag sink is absent from the immediate parent.
